bugs.title: Hardcoded JWT secret
bugs.description: JWT_SECRET is a hardcoded string literal instead of environment variable

bugs.title: JWT token has no expiration
bugs.description: jwt.sign called without expiresIn option — tokens never expire

bugs.title: Non-constant-time password comparison
bugs.description: Using === for hash comparison instead of crypto.timingSafeEqual, vulnerable to timing attacks

bugs.title: User enumeration via different error messages
bugs.description: Different responses for 'no account found' vs 'invalid password' leaks whether email exists

bugs.title: Reset token returned in HTTP response
bugs.description: Password reset token sent in JSON response instead of only via email — allows token interception

bugs.title: Reset token expiry not checked
bugs.description: reset-password endpoint validates token existence but not reset_expiry — expired tokens work forever

bugs.title: Weak session ID using Math.random
bugs.description: Session ID generated with Math.random which is not cryptographically secure — predictable sessions

bugs.title: Cookie missing secure and sameSite flags
bugs.description: Session cookie set without secure:true and sameSite attribute — vulnerable to MITM and CSRF
